comments.text: I miss the 70's. I was fortunate to have grown up during the singer-songwriter era and got to hear a lot of great music. Although I was too young to have experienced any of the emotions of these songs I felt that it was helping me prepare for the adult world. It wasn't going to be all fun times.
comments.author: @madahab64
